svg.title: The League of Amazing Programmers — laser-engraving outline (checkpoint 1)
svg.desc: Pure vector outline version for laser engraving: every shape is a real traced path (potrace), fill:none, stroke:black, vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke on every individual path (non-inherited per spec, so it's set directly on each one) to keep a uniform 3px line weight regardless of the nested per-element scaling used to lay out the wordmark -- no embedded raster images, no text elements/webfonts, so it imports as clean engravable vector paths in any laser software. Traced from the same checkpoint-1 geometry as logo-arced-1.svg.
